mapping.Pi: individuate recurrent neural state, synaptic weights, thresholds, readout and external sequence/target roles
mapping.X: time-indexed SORN configuration carrying recurrent activity and learned plastic state
mapping.C: network connectivity, plasticity, normalization and task admissibility constraints
mapping.Q: task/readout criterion used for supervised output selection; not a generic coordinator objective
mapping.P_in: external stimulus-sequence input and supervised training signal
mapping.K: recurrent state transition plus STDP/IP/SN learned transformations
